finalText:
Migration finished. 36 call sites across 12 files converted to `db.execute({ sql, params })`:

| Package | Files |
|---|---|
| accounts | `repo/session.js`, `service/teamService.js`, `admin/apiKeyAdmin.js` |
| analytics | `repo/cohort.js` |
| billing | `repo/refund.js`, `service/couponService.js` |
| catalog | `repo/supplier.js`, `admin/variantAdmin.js` |
| orders | `repo/shipment.js`, `service/returnService.js` |
| support | `repo/sla.js`, `admin/macroAdmin.js` |

All rewritten files pass `node --check`, and `db.query` no longer appears anywhere under `packages/`.

Two things I deliberately left alone:

- **`vendor/legacy-orm/adapter.js:9,13`** — still on `db.query`. The file header says it's a vendored copy of legacy-orm 2.1.4, replaced wholesale on upgrade with local changes silently lost, so patching it in place would be undone by the next vendor bump. Since `lib/db.js` notes the driver's next major drops `query()` entirely, this needs a real fix rather than an edit: upgrade legacy-orm to a version using the new form, or wrap the adapter with a local shim that maps its calls onto `db.execute`. Tell me which you'd prefer and I'll do it.
- **`cache.query(...)`** — appears in ~20 repo files but is `lib/cache.js`'s own API, unrelated to the db handle. Untouched.
